changes.packages/cli/src/cleanup/lifecycle.ts: Added evidence-preserving content-addressed compaction: .agent/runs/** raw run/checkpoints classified as RETIRED/ephemeral_helper_or_test compaction candidates; archive objects stored at .agent/archive/objects/<sha256>; tombstone (.agent/tombstones/compact-*.json, schema artifact/cleanup-compaction-tombstone) written BEFORE archiving; originals removed only after object hash verification and byte-equal restore probe (round-trip); archive manifest .agent/archive/manifest.json (schema harness/content-addressed-archive/v1); recovery of interrupted compactions from content hashes + pending tombstones (re-archive from original or verify existing object, fail closed on mismatch); compaction stays planned-only unless non-dry-run AND --compact; .agent/archive/** classified RETIRED/content_addressed_archive never re-archived; LifecycleReport extended with compaction: CompactionReport (schema artifact/cleanup-compaction-report). Preserved PURGE_ELIGIBLE/activeReference strings required by the authoritative v3.1 directive audit.
changes.packages/cli/src/commands/cleanup.ts: Added --compact option gating content-addressed compaction; compaction applied only when non-dry-run AND --compact (cleanup lifecycle --apply --compact); lifecycle message includes compaction candidate/applied counts; usage documents --compact. Preserved --apply literal required by validate-v31-directive.mjs.
changes.automation/verify-all.mjs: Replaced phase-specific hard-coded V3/V3.1 validator runs with generic pointer-driven validation: PLAN_VALIDATORS registry keyed by plan identity; authority derived at runtime from .agent/current.json (work_id/plan_id); current plan's validators run as blocking authoritative gates, completed-phase validators run as non-authoritative compatibility checks (reported, never failing the run, never deleted) so historical terminal proof stays runnable.
changes.automation/validate-ci-timeouts.mjs: Created C-015/V-015 audit: every job requires positive timeout-minutes (fails with exact job name); wait-on steps require explicit --timeout/-t (fails with exact step name); playwright install / control-plane start|stop steps require step-level timeout-minutes; npm audit/semgrep/gitleaks external-check steps require step-level timeout-minutes; quality.yml must trigger pull_request (hosted quality required-capable); certification.yml must not trigger pull_request/merge_group (cannot be a required check); certification.yml must contain a bounded watchdog cancelling queued self-hosted certify jobs with RUNNERS_UNAVAILABLE advisory exit 78 and certify-aggregate must map skipped|cancelled to the advisory path. Emits JSON report; exit 0 when clean.
changes..github/workflows/quality.yml: Bounded high-risk steps: Playwright preflight Linux 20min / Windows+macOS 15min; Start Control Plane 5min; Wait for Control Plane 5min with explicit 'npx wait-on --timeout 120000' (fails the exact step on never-succeeding wait); Cleanup Control Plane 5min; npm audit/semgrep/gitleaks 15min; added timeout-minutes: 10 to quality-aggregate. Hosted quality remains a pull_request-triggered required check.
changes..github/workflows/certification.yml: Added certify-watchdog job (hosted ubuntu, timeout-minutes 15, permissions actions:write): polls run jobs; exits 0 when certify matrix reaches running/terminal state; at the 840s deadline cancels still-queued self-hosted certify jobs and exits 78 with RUNNERS_UNAVAILABLE advisory (certification is not a required check, so this never blocks merges). certify-aggregate now maps skipped|cancelled to RUNNERS_UNAVAILABLE advisory (exit 78), keeping genuine NATIVE_HOST_FAILED (exit 79) distinct.
